posts.description: Had a little play with an iPhone Duo yesterday, it’s an intriguing device. I wish the iPad homescreen worked the same as the Duo’s.

Most frustrating. You can no longer go to a bank with a bunch of coins you’ve saved up and swap them for notes. It must first be paid into an account and then you can withdraw it again, of course I didn’t go to my bank to do it, just the first bank I got to.
Dark chocolate digestives and a cup of tea are like cryptonite for me at the moment. Impossible to resist.
